## Selected Case Studies & Measurable Outcomes

1. **E-Commerce Website Redesign & Speed Revamp (D2C Apparel Brand, Coimbatore)**
   - Problem: Outdated site with 6.8s load times and poor checkout conversion.
   - Solution: Rebuilt on custom lightweight WordPress + WooCommerce with 1-page checkout.
   - Outcome: +140% Checkout Conversion Rate, 1.1s load speed, ₹35L+ monthly GMV.

2. **SaaS Landing Page & Web Application (B2B Tech Studio, Bangalore)**
   - Problem: Complex technical messaging failing to convert demo requests.
   - Solution: Designed high-contrast editorial UI with interactive ROI calculator and streamlined booking.
   - Outcome: 3.4x Demo Signups, 68% lower bounce rate.

3. **Local Business Website & Local SEO Architecture (Industrial Firm, Coimbatore)**
   - Problem: Zero organic search visibility and complete reliance on offline referrals.
   - Solution: Developed an authoritative web portal targeting commercial keywords across Tamil Nadu.
   - Outcome: #1 Google ranking for 12+ primary commercial keywords, 50+ monthly inbound RFQs.
